assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent character design sheet used as the central artwork of a dark graph-based character-design workspace.
Input image 1 is a style and character-design reference ONLY: take the original silver-haired woman in its central character card. Do not reproduce the app interface, panel borders, graph, text, labels, annotation boxes, background or controls.
Primary request: create a standalone original adult Japanese anime game heroine character turnaround sheet. She is clearly an adult woman in her mid-twenties. Preserve the reference's specific character identity and outfit: short layered silver-gray hair with wispy bangs, amber golden eyes, reserved confident expression; dark navy blue technical oversized cropped jacket with black structured high collar, desaturated teal edge binding and vertical webbing strap, small aged-gold crescent-shaped buckle/clasp at the upper torso; fitted black high-neck inner layer; charcoal gray loose cargo trousers with technical seams, straps and small muted brass fittings; black heavy lace-up ankle boots with thick soles; black gloves. Tasteful fully clothed game character.
Style: refined Japanese anime game concept art, clear fine hand-drawn outlines, polished restrained cel-paint shading with painterly fabric folds, realistic matte nylon and metal details, silver hair luminous against dark UI. Keep the exact muted dark-navy, charcoal, teal, gold palette.
Composition: portrait canvas, intended 900 x 1400 pixels or closest portrait aspect ratio. One large complete front full-body figure on the left/center, about 85% image height, head and both boot soles entirely visible, graceful neutral standing pose with arms slightly apart. One separate small complete back-view of the same woman at the lower right, about 32% image height, showing matching back jacket, trousers and boots. Generous transparent margin around ALL figures so none are cropped. The small back view must not overlap the large figure.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no scene, no ground plane, no drop shadows, no gradient, no checkerboard painted into the image. Only the two character cutouts. No typography, arrows, swatches, watermarks, UI, framing, symbols or extraneous accessories. Preserve full body proportions and outfit coherence between front and back.
